text:
anya: heads-up: saw 20-30% drop in kv-replay hits from rack-17 around 11:12 UTC. packet counters spiked then recovered.

sam: link? curious if it's the new proxy pacing change we rolled last night.

anya: infra-bot alerted: [ALERT] rack-heartbeat-mesh: heartbeat-latency > 200ms for 3 min on rack-17

infra-bot: Incident created: I-8240001 — rack heartbeat mesh jitter detected — paging eng-infra

lee: I grabbed the tail of the logs, looks like our proxy (edge-proxy-2) started qdisc shaping when NIC queue filled. TCP retransmits up ~1.8x

maria: could be related to dedicated carveout test in eu-west; routing shim pinned some traffic to racks 15-18.

sam: @maria we did a soft carve for dedicated pools at 02:00 UTC. Did we enable the new fast-evict? :thinking:

maria: yes, soft-evict enabled. I didn't think it'd touch heartbeat probes; maybe the mesh takes a lower priority and gets paced.

anya: here's the command I ran to repro (from node):
```
# show qdisc
tc -s qdisc show dev eth0
kubectl logs -n infra edge-proxy-2 | grep heartbeat | tail -n 50
```

lee: theory: mesh heartbeats are low-bandwidth but latency-sensitive. Our proxy pacing lumps them into the same token bucket as KV replication, so when bursty KV goes, heartbeats get delayed.

sam: mitigation idea: tag heartbeat traffic with DSCP/TC and separate qdisc class. Also make warm-pool heartbeat route prefer non-dedicated slices.

maria: agree. We should also add a fallback at routing layer: if heartbeat latency > 150ms for 2 mins, route control plane to backup proxy in other rack.

anya: cost tradeoff: carving out control traffic from KV reduces efficiency but improves stability. Need ops approval.

lee: quick patch we can roll: mark control traffic with `traffic-class=control` and add shaper rule. I'll prepare PR and can roll to canary in us-west1 first.

maria: add evals to Redwood Optimize: simulate KV burst + control heartbeat to measure tail p95.

sam: action items:
- lee: PR for qdisc/class (canary us-west) — due EOD
- maria: update routing fallback and alerts — due tomorrow AM
- anya: add runbook snippet and link to I-8240001

anya: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/rack-heartbeat-mesh

infra-bot: Change rolled: deploy/edge-proxy-2 v3.21 -> v3.22 (sam) at 11:30 UTC :rocket:

lee: rolled canary to us-west1 — monitoring p95 now. Will report in 10m.

sam: :thumbsup:
